mechanical.basis: A description of how the closing market has historically discounted each piece of EdgeDesk’s number (fit 2021-2025, holdout R² 0.03). It explains, it never prices.

explanation.market_implied: EdgeDesk rates Indiana 16.8 pts better on a neutral field. Holding everything else at EdgeDesk’s values, the market’s number implies Indiana 15.2 pts better — the disagreement sits in team strength unless the market is pricing something else.
explanation.actionable_reason: EdgeDesk’s articles are research. A gap is never presented as a bet; any betting decision belongs to EdgeDesk’s decision engine, at a live price.
